result.finding: Oracle Database Free 23ai is the only external system dependency. It serves dual purposes: relational metadata storage and BLOB-based photo binary storage. No caching, authentication services, file shares, or message queues.
evidence: README.md: Oracle Database 21c Express Edition listed as technology stack component
Photo.java: @Lob byte[] photoData — binary photo data stored in Oracle as BLOB
No LDAP, Active Directory, S3, Azure Blob, Redis, or message queue references found
values: Oracle Database Free 23ai (external RDBMS + BLOB store)
JDBC connection: oracle:thin driver on port 1521
Database schema: PHOTOS table with BLOB column for photo data
No S3/Azure Blob (photos stored in Oracle BLOB)
